subject: English
title: 她為什麼常常晚回家

panels.heading: 先看回家的事件
panels.text: 題目要問她經常晚回家的原因。
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

panels.heading: 把「常常」連到事件
panels.text: often 對應頻率，late 描述回到家的時間。
panels.alt: 由圖形對照反覆到家和時間很晚
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

panels.heading: why 引出原因
panels.text: she 配 comes，後面補 home late。
panels.alt: 圖解 why、she、often comes 的順序
panels.caption: 新製教學示意

fourth.answer: I need to know why she often comes home late.
points: she 配 comes，後面補 home late。
fourth.alt: 頻率 often與到家很晚的圖示，標出 she often comes home late

answerCheckedAgainst: I need to know why she often comes home late.
